podcast.title: Daily Motown Visits as a Postman
podcast.body: After his work as a postman, Freddie Gorman, a former bandmate of Brian Holland in The Fidelitones, would regularly "pop into Motown" due to his continued musical ambitions. This routine led to his involvement in writing "Please Mr. Postman." "Gorman still had musical ambitions, and he would pop into Motown every day after he finished work as a postman."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 93: "Please Mr. Postman" by the Marvelettes

podcast.title: End of Songwriting Partnership with Brian Holland
podcast.body: Freddie Gorman's songwriting collaboration with Brian Holland ended when Holland began completing song ideas with his brother Eddie and Lamont Dozier before Freddie could contribute. This marked a shift in Holland's creative partnerships. "Freddie kept finding that when he came round to hit the film after work, if Brian Holland had had an idea for a song, he'd already finished it, usually with the help of his brother ready and their new writing partner, Lamont Dozier."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
